# Anthem Madness (Anthem Madness by adjiebrotot)

> Free sheet music (PDF) and MIDI files of national anthems in full orchestral arrangements: the official melody, a part for every instrument and the full score, by Adjie Brotosukmono (adjiebrotot).

Canonical site: https://anthem.adjiebrotots.com/
Sitemap: https://anthem.adjiebrotots.com/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://anthem.adjiebrotots.com/robots.txt
Creator: Adjie Brotosukmono (adjiebrotot), https://www.adjiebrotots.com/ (profile for LLMs: https://www.adjiebrotots.com/llms.txt). Sister sites: https://tool.adjiebrotots.com/ (tools), https://blog.adjiebrotots.com/ (blog).
Access: free, no account. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 where the melody is in the public domain; where it is still in copyright the melody belongs to its owner and the arrangement is CC BY 4.0. Credit: arranged for orchestra by adjiebrotot (anthem.adjiebrotots.com).

## How the site is laid out

- https://anthem.adjiebrotots.com/<country>/ : the anthem: the full orchestra score in concert pitch, drawn in the browser and played along with the orchestra MIDI in a SoundFont synth (the notes light up as they sound); full orchestra MIDI, chorus MIDI, melody MIDI, full-score PDF, facts (composer, lyricist, adoption, key, tempo, length).
- https://anthem.adjiebrotots.com/<country>/melody/ : the melody as a lead sheet (with lyrics where sung), PDF and MIDI.
- https://anthem.adjiebrotots.com/<country>/<instrument>/ : that instrument's parts as sheet music, a PDF and a MIDI per part. Instruments: violin, viola, cello, double-bass, piccolo, flute, oboe, clarinet (in B flat), bassoon, horn (French horn in F), trumpet (in B flat), trombone, tuba, timpani, percussion, harp, piano, choir.
- The melodies are the official tunes, note for note; only the orchestration is new.

## Anthems

- [Himno Nacional Argentino](https://anthem.adjiebrotots.com/argentina/): national anthem of Argentina; Bb major, 4/4, 2:44; instruments: piccolo, flute, oboe, clarinet, bassoon, horn, trumpet, trombone, tuba, timpani, percussion, harp, choir, violin, viola, cello, double-bass.
- [The ASEAN Way](https://anthem.adjiebrotots.com/asean/): anthem of ASEAN (ASEAN Anthem); D major, lift to E, 4/4, 1:52; instruments: flute, oboe, clarinet, horn, trumpet, trombone, tuba, timpani, percussion, piano, choir, violin, viola, cello, double-bass.
